stories.headline: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on day one
stories.voiceover: GTA 6 made nearly three point eight billion dollars on day one. The biggest entertainment launch ever.
stories.concept: a cash register counter rolls up to $3.79B, coins stack into a tower that rises past a trophy shelf labelled MOVIES / MUSIC / GAMES, a crown settles on top
stories.source: Take-Two Interactive press release (Nov 20: $3.79B day-one retail sales through end of Nov 19, 32.5M units pre-release, biggest entertainment launch in history), TweakTown, Wccftech

photo.credit: Photo: Take-Two Interativa de / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons

stories.headline: The Nasdaq fell 5.3% on Friday
stories.voiceover: On Friday, the Nasdaq dropped five point three percent. That wiped out all its gains this year.
stories.concept: a chart line drifts down a long slide like a leaf, the 2026 gains bar drains like sand in an hourglass to zero
stories.source: NBC News (Nasdaq -5.3%, erased 2026 gains, S&P -3.7%), Yahoo Finance (Nasdaq 22,617.73 -5.28%), QNC News; CNBC on AI selloff context

stories.headline: Canva added an off switch for AI
stories.voiceover: Canva just added an off switch for AI. Flip it, and its generative AI tools vanish.
stories.concept: a giant toggle labelled 'Enable generative AI features' slides off, sparkly AI buttons float away like bubbles and pop softly, a calm clean canvas remains
stories.source: 9to5Mac (Nov 19), Engadget (Nov 19): toggle under Profile > Settings > Permissions, Free and Pro, Background Remover and Magic Grab stay

stories.headline: Gemini can now use your Mac for you
stories.voiceover: And Google's Gemini can now use your Mac for you, clicking, typing and filling in forms.
stories.concept: a Mac window where a glowing cursor moves by itself, clicks a button, types text letter by letter, ticks form boxes, a 'Done' check blooms
stories.source: Android Authority (Nov 19), Talk Android (Nov 20) citing Google Keyword blog: computer use in Gemini for Mac, AI Plus/Pro/Ultra, US English, Apple Silicon

photo.credit: Photo: Google / Public domain / Wikimedia Commons
